title: The MacBook Pro M5 Isn’t Apple’s Newest Laptop, but It’s the Best to Buy Right Now
gist: Wired argues the previous-gen 14-inch MacBook Pro M5, discounted $200 to $1,799 at Amazon, is a better buy than Apple's new M6 model, whose gains are mostly two extra CPU/GPU cores and AI-oriented hardware. The M6 bump is described as one of the smallest gen-over-gen Apple Silicon improvements in six years.

insights.claim: Apple's M6 14-inch MacBook Pro, refreshed in October 2026, is physically identical to the late-2025 M5 model, differing mainly in the chip and a move to Wi-Fi 7.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Apple is iterating silicon without hardware redesigns, limiting the reason for M5 owners to upgrade.
insights.quote: It's identical to the previous-gen M5 model, which came out in late 2025.

insights.claim: According to Wired's reviewer, the M6's two extra CPU and GPU cores make it one of the smallest generation-over-generation Apple Silicon performance bumps in the past six years.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Slowing per-generation gains in Apple Silicon could lengthen Mac replacement cycles.
insights.quote: it's one of the smaller gen-over-gen Apple Silicon performance bumps in the past six years

insights.claim: The M6's main improvement is AI performance, from a second 16-core Neural Engine and faster memory bandwidth, which the reviewer expects to go largely unnoticed in everyday and content-creation work.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Apple is spending its silicon budget on on-device AI before there is a clear consumer workload for it, which is a test of AI-PC demand.
insights.quote: The main difference is in AI performance, thanks to the second 16-core Neural Engine and faster memory bandwidth on the M6.

insights.claim: The 14-inch MacBook Pro M5 is selling at $1,799 on Amazon, 10% below its $1,999 list price and $200 cheaper than the otherwise identical M6 model.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Retailer discounting of prior-gen stock cannibalizes demand for Apple's new model at full price.
insights.quote: you can currently get the M5 for $200 less on Amazon and Walmart

insights.claim: The 15-inch MacBook Air M5 with 16 GB of memory and 1 TB of storage is at $1,549, its lowest price since June and $150 below Apple's retail price, while the 13-inch model is at $1,099 on Amazon (15% off).
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Discounts across the Mac line ahead of Black Friday point to aggressive holiday pricing.
insights.quote: The model with 16 GB of memory and a terabyte of storage is at its lowest price since June: $1,549.

insights.claim: The base 14-inch MacBook Pro is not a true pro-performance laptop because it uses the same M5 chip as the MacBook Air and iPad Pro, so its main advantages over the Air are the brighter mini-LED HDR display and extra ports such as HDMI and an SD card slot.
insights.speaker: Luke Larsen
insights.so_what: Sharing one chip across Apple's products blurs the line between tiers, which pushes buyers toward the cheaper Air.
insights.quote: the base 14-inch MacBook Pro isn't a true pro laptop in terms of performance
